subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do the CI/security workflow owners approve the proposed immutable revisions for actions that mint GitHub App tokens, authenticate to registries, or run Codex with an API key?
rationale: The patch has no demonstrated source-level defect, but this is a trust decision about upgraded third-party executable code in privileged workflows and cannot be safely inferred from routine CI alone.

options.title: Approve after targeted action audit
options.body: Review the upstream revision diffs and release notes for the token, registry, and Codex actions, then merge the grouped Dependabot update if their contracts remain acceptable.

options.title: Split privileged revisions
options.body: Hold or split the App-token, Docker-login, and Codex-action revisions while allowing separately reviewed low-privilege workflow action updates.

recommendation.title: Approve after targeted action audit
recommendation.body: Review the upstream revision diffs and release notes for the token, registry, and Codex actions, then merge the grouped Dependabot update if their contracts remain acceptable.
